title: Trump says he ordered DOJ suit to block Alaska Senate race certification if Republican loses
summary_full: There are two Dan Sullivans on the ballot in the Senate race in Alaska. The DOJ says that fact could help Democratic nominee Mary Peltola defeat both of them.
